extracted.intended_audience: Prospective KAKENHI applicants (principal investigators) and affiliated institution administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing and submitting the Research Proposal Document and required forms for JSPS Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research (A/B/C), Challenging Research (Pioneering/Exploratory), and Early-Career Scientists via the JSPS Electronic Application System. Covers required document composition, required forms per grant category, deadlines, and institutional submission/confirmation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application period and strict submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: Application Period Monday, July 14–4:30 pm on Wednesday, September 17, 2025 (to be strictly observed) (JST). Deadline for submission 4:30 pm on Wednesday, September 17, 2025 (to be strictly observed) (JST).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deadlines are to be strictly observed. The JSPS Electronic Application System will be available for use on Tuesday, July 22. (Page notes that application procedures for FY2026 have closed and the information is for reference.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission via the JSPS Electronic Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: Go to the JSPS Electronic Application System (hereinafter “the System”) after you have been issued with an ID and a password to the System by your affiliated institution. Fill out all fields on the web-based form and upload your complete application form(s) to the System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The System is the required channel for entering website items and uploading forms. You can check the status of your application through the System.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obtain institutional ID/password before using the System
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be issued with an ID and a password to the System by your affiliated institution before accessing the JSPS Electronic Application System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants cannot access the System without institutional credentials; institution administrators will handle credential issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check researcher information registered in e-Rad before preparing proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: In making an application, be sure to check your researcher information registration in e-Rad before preparing your Research Proposal Document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For more information, refer to page 36 of the Application Procedures for Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research-KAKENHI-. Confirmation of researcher information in e-Rad is a prerequisite to preparing the Research Proposal Document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Composition of the Research Proposal Document (two-part structure)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Proposal Document consists of the following two parts; "Items to be entered in the Website" and "Forms to be uploaded".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must complete both parts: web-entered items and uploaded files (word/PDF forms). Specific guidance documents and example images for overall and part layouts are provided for each grant category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Items to be entered in the Website (PI responsibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Proposal Document (items to be entered in the Website: Research Project Information, Research Expenditure and Their Necessity, The Status of Application and Acquisition of Research Grants) must be filled out by the Principal Investigator on the web-based forms of the JSPS Electronic Application System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These specific website fields are mandatory and must be completed by the PI via the web forms (see Procedures for Preparing and Entering a Research Proposal Document (items to be entered in the Website)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms to be uploaded (PI responsibility and prescribed templates)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Research Proposal Document (forms to be uploaded: research plan, etc.) must be prepared by the Principal Investigator using the following forms and uploaded to the JSPS Electronic Application System.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the specified Word/PDF forms for your grant category (e.g., S-12 for Scientific Research (A), S-13 for (B), S-14 for (C), S-21 for Early-Career Scientists, S-41-1/S-41-2 for Challenging Research (Pioneering), S-42-1/S-42-2 for Challenging Research (Exploratory)). Procedures PDFs provide detailed instructions for preparing and entering uploaded forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select correct grant category and corresponding form(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Step 1: Select the grant category you prefer and download application form(s) posted below.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each grant category has distinct forms and overall image/layouts. Ensure you use the form (e.g., S-12, S-13, S-14, S-21, S-41-1/S-41-2, S-42-1/S-42-2) that matches the category you are applying to.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare application completely and verify completeness before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Step 2: Prepare your application and check you have completed it in full.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are responsible for verifying that all required website items and uploaded forms are complete and conform to the prescribed templates before uploading to the System.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adding co-investigators via the System
rubrics_metrics.description: You can add co-investigator(s) to your planned project through the System, if necessary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Co-investigator addition is handled in the electronic application; follow System procedures to include collaborators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional confirmation, immutability after confirmation
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your application online by the deadline set by your institution. Once your application has been confirmed by your institution, you may not make any changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is an institutional review/confirmation step; after institution confirmation the application is locked and cannot be edited. Check your institution's internal deadline and process as it may be earlier than the central deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Observe restrictions on parallel applications and check review/section tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Table of Restriction on Parallel Grant Application/Receipt, Review Section Table, and List of Sections That Are Subject to Joint Review (Attached Tables 1–3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must consult the attached tables to confirm whether parallel applications/receipts are restricted for specific grant combinations, the appropriate review section, and any sections subject to joint review (e.g., sections subject to joint review in Scientific Research (B)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the provided explanatory materials and procedures documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Explanatory Materials and FAQs, Application Procedures, Supplement, Procedures for Preparing and Entering a Research Proposal Document (items to be entered in the Website), and Procedures for Preparing and Entering a Research Proposal Document (forms to be uploaded) are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the provided PDFs (Application Procedures, Supplement, Major Changes, and category-specific procedures) for detailed instructions, formatting, and examples; major changes in the call for proposals are documented separately.
